nodes.label: Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability
nodes.rationale: The concern is correctness, not speed: .sort() mutates in place, so sorting a prop inside useMemo mutates the caller's array, breaking React's read-only props/state model and producing stale-closure bugs. .toSorted() returns a new array (Chrome 110+, Safari 16+, Firefox 115+, Node 20+), with [...items].sort() as the older-runtime fallback. Sibling immutable methods: toReversed, toSpliced, with. Impact MEDIUM-HIGH.
